change: Use ADB_SERVER_SOCKET=tcp:5054 so adb can auto-start the isolated local daemon.

validation.sharedSpawnEnvironment: all three spawn sites use the same env

officialSources.finding: ADB_SERVER_SOCKET takes precedence over environment host/port, and a hostless server address is built as tcp:<port>.
Official unit test accepts a port-only TCP socket and parses an empty hostname.
Local TCP host classification accepts an empty hostname or literal localhost; the actual CI adb log confirms numeric loopback was rejected.

remainingGate: A new authorized CI commit must launch the emulator and execute all 99 native cases.
